N01.description: Melamchi river surge washed away suspension footbridges and flooded riverside terrace farms.
Heavy monsoon rains triggered slope failure, blocking arterial road NR3 for 48 hours.
Unseasonal heavy snowfall in upper catchment isolated upper pastures and disrupted communications.
N01.outcome: Winter relief supplies distributed via 4x4 convoys

N01.description: Upstream glacial lake outburst and cloudburst triggered massive debris flow destroying 60 buildings.
N01.outcome: Army helicopter rescue operations and emergency shelter established

N01.description: Melamchi river swelled again, eroding reinforced riverbanks and threatening valley school.
Intense localized cloudburst dropped 140mm in 2 hours, cutting primary ground access entirely.
N01.outcome: Air corridor airlift activated for medical evacuees

N01.description: Magnitude 5.1 tremor triggered rockfalls along upper canyon passes, blocking supply vehicles.
N01.outcome: Road cleared by Nepal Army engineers

N02.description: Steep hillside failure blocked road NR5 and damaged 18 residential stone homes.
N02.outcome: Displaced families sheltered in community hall

N02.description: Violent squall and hail damaged hillside terrace crops and tin roofs.
Torrential monsoon rains swollen mountain river, flooding riverside market stalls.
Deep-seated slope reactivation threatened central market ridge with ground fissure movement.
N02.outcome: Partial evacuation to Chautara safe grounds

N02.description: Dry spring pine forest fire approached eastern fringe settlements before containment.
N02.outcome: Contained by fire-line cutting and aerial water bucket drop

N02.description: Gully washout deposited tons of gravel and boulders across agricultural terraces.

N03.description: Continuous rain induced mudslide across foothill road NR4, delaying transit.
High-intensity lightning strikes knocked out ridge telecom repeater towers.
N03.outcome: Telecom restored via solar backup generator

N03.description: Mountain stream breached culvert, eroding road edge near district hospital.
Heavy monsoon rains caused slope failure above settlement, requiring precautionary evacuation.
Sub-zero cold spell caused water pipe freezing and agricultural frost damage.

N04.description: High altitude snow avalanche severed mule trail and buried upper outpost storage shed.
N04.outcome: Trail reopened by mountain rescue teams

N04.description: Intense cloudburst washed away two pedestrian wooden bridges, isolating northern settlements.
Glacial stream overflow destroyed road connection NR6, leaving the zone completely cut off.
N04.outcome: Helicopter airlift established as sole lifeline

N04.description: Three feet of snowfall halted all trekking routes and caused livestock losses.
N04.outcome: Snow clearance performed by local volunteers

N04.description: Seismic activity triggered cliff collapse, blocking the gorge and damaging 85% of infrastructure.
N04.outcome: High-altitude airlift of all vulnerable persons

N04.description: Rapid snowmelt coupled with rainfall eroded valley terrace foundations.

N05.description: Salinadi river burst banks, flooding historic peri-urban settlements and brick kilns.
N05.outcome: Rescue teams deployed boats for evacuation

N05.description: Drainage canal overflow inundated agricultural lowlands and connecting link road NR1.
Squall wind and lightning damaged electric feeder transformers.
Upstream torrential rains flooded 220 ground-floor houses and artisan workshops.
N05.outcome: Community schools served as temporary shelters

N05.description: Extended rainfall saturated agricultural basin, slowing outbound commodity transit.

N06.description: Hanumante river overflow flooded eastern cultural basin and market access routes.
N06.outcome: Dewatering pumps operated in heritage zones

N06.description: Intense 80mm rainfall caused street flooding and blocked low bridges.
Basin water level rose rapidly, inundating pottery squares and ground floor shops.
N06.outcome: Emergency boat rescue deployed by Nepal Armed Police

N06.description: High winds damaged temple restoration scaffolding and power poles.
River backflow flooded low-lying bus park and access highway NR2.
N06.outcome: Traffic diverted to high bypass road

N06.description: Pre-monsoon storm runoff caused basement inundations in residential wards.

N07.description: Heavy continuous rains caused roadside embankment erosion along highway NR8.
Lightning damaged ridge telecom antennas and solar transmission hubs.
Runoff from northern ridge ponded in lower gateway roundabout.
Pine ridge fire threatened outer hotel and hospital zone perimeters.
Slope failure near highway junction obstructed emergency transport corridor.

N08.description: Puniavati stream overflowed, submerging main trade highway NR7 and shops.
Monsoon cloudburst flooded low-lying Banepa bus terminal under 0.8m of water.
Sudden torrential surge flooded 300 business premises and disrupted Kathmandu artery.
Hail and high winds damaged greenhouse plastic tunnels and power cables.
Drainage overflow inundated market core, causing temporary commercial shutdown.

N09.description: Major rockfall collapsed 120m of Araniko Highway NR10, completely cutting border access.
N09.outcome: Nepal Army deployed rock blasters to reopen trail

N09.description: Violent glacial river surge eroded road embankments and washed away border check-post stalls.
N09.outcome: Customs operations shifted to temporary tents

N09.description: Heavy snowfall induced chute avalanche, blocking Kodari mountain pass for 5 days.
Intense cloudburst unleashed massive boulder debris slide, flattening 14 transit warehouses.
N09.outcome: Air force helicopters evacuated stranded transport crews

N09.description: M4.9 localized tremor triggered widespread cliff fractures and rock falls on pass.
Continuous 96-hour rain saturated gorge face, creating an impassable 300m mud barrier.
N09.outcome: Airlift corridor established to Kodari outpost

N09.description: Meltwater surge swept away temporary Bailey bridge, cutting northern border trade.

N10.description: Jhikhu Khola stream breached banks, submerging 400 hectares of commercial vegetable crops.
N10.outcome: Agricultural relief and subsidized seed distribution

N10.description: Extended drought dropped irrigation canal discharge by 65% across valley farms.
High-intensity monsoon deluge caused fast-flowing floodwaters to inundate 180 valley houses.
Lightning strikes killed farm livestock and disrupted local power transformer.
Stream overflow inundated link road NR9, slowing vegetable produce transport.
N10.outcome: Road cleared of mud once water receded

N10.description: Continuous rain caused standing water in low-elevation valley depressions.
N10.outcome: Natural percolation and drainage ditches opened
